candidates.change_summary: Change the return value from true to false.
Change the require condition from > 0 to == 0, so transfer reverts when _tos is non-empty instead of empty.
Change the return value from true to false, so the function returns false on success.
Delete the require statement, allowing calls with empty _tos array which would previously revert.

Delete the return true statement, causing the function to not return a bool and thus fail compiler type checking — compiling as equivalent to removing the return, the external behavior changes from returning a value to reverting/not returning.
Change the function selector from transferFrom to transfer, causing a different external call and likely reverting or different external state change.
Change the amount computation exponent from _decimals to a constant, e.g., 18, altering the transferred value for custom decimals.
Change the loop variable increment from i++ to i+=2, skipping every other recipient.
Delete the entire loop body (the external call and revert), so no external transfers occur but return true is still reached.
